name: Stolen Supplies

angles.text: The raids break the lifeline between the highlands and lowlands. Without regular deliveries of food and windstones, skyborne townsfolk go hungry.

faq.answer: Caravans between the lowlands and highlands carried food and windstones. Regular deliveries help keep local townsfolk fed and supplied.
faq.q: What supplies were stolen from the caravans?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh have raided the supply caravans for months. They blame ordinary bandits, yet stolen packs keep turning up in Falaath Village.
faq.q: Who is responsible for raiding the caravans?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh store the stolen supply packs in Falaath Village, within the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: Where are the stolen supply caches being held?

faq.answer: The caravans carry food and windstones between the lowlands and highlands. The raids leave local skyborne short of supplies while highland goods gather in Falaath Village.
faq.q: Why are these supply caravans being targeted?

faq.answer: Once recovered, the supplies go to the local constable and authorities. They redistribute them to the townsfolk most in need of food and relief.
faq.q: What happens to the supplies once they are recovered?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh blame roving bandits to deflect responsibility. Yet stolen cargo keeps turning up in their settlement at Falaath Village.
faq.q: Why do the Al'Aketh blame bandits for the raids?

sections.body: For months, raiders have attacked caravans on the road between the lowlands and the Shen'dar Highlands. Their wagons carry food and windstones that highland settlements depend on. As fewer deliveries arrive, townsfolk struggle to get by, and some draw close to starvation.
sections.title: Raids on the Highland Lifeline

sections.body: The Al'Aketh blame common bandits for the attacks. Yet the missing supplies keep turning up in Falaath Village, where the Al'Aketh store the stolen packs. The recovered goods go to the local authorities and constable, who send them straight to the skyborne in greatest need.
sections.title: The Falaath Cache

summary: Caravans bound for the Shen'dar Highlands are under attack, and their stolen goods gather in Falaath Village. Food and windstones grow scarce in the highland settlements, leaving some skyborne close to starvation.
